# Repo skills

## review-crontick

Use `/review-crontick` or ask Copilot to "review crontick changes" to run the
repo-local architecture review for crontick code or PR changes. The review checks
single-core/thin-shim layering, drift between CLI/MCP/API surfaces, actionable
errors, generated schemas/state, and dead or unnecessary code.

GitHub Copilot code review on PRs can be pointed at repo instructions, but this
skill is currently invoked manually.
